items.summary: In June the American Federation Of Musicians sued Universal and Warner over their AI deals, insisting the majors should be sharing their AI money with the union’s members under its Sound Recording Labor Agreement. Both sides have made new court filings as the majors try to get the lawsuit dismissed

items.summary: In March, American producer Michael Smith pleaded guilty to one count of conspiracy to commit wire fraud, following accusations that he had botted his way to more than $10m in royalties for his AI-generated music. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Trabajo por encargo: quién queda como autor se pacta por escrito
tip.body: Si produces para un cliente, define por contrato si cedes derechos, si conservas puntos de producción y si tu nombre aparece en los créditos. Sin contrato, la interpretación depende de la ley de cada país.

tip.title: Work for hire: put authorship in writing
tip.body: If you produce for a client, spell out in the contract whether you assign rights, keep producer points, and get credited. Without a contract, the outcome depends on each country's law.
